statement: NVIDIA Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion in Q2 FY2027, up 18% sequentially and 117% year over year.
why: Data Center revenue is the direct scoreboard for merchant-GPU demand actually converting into shipments.

impact.mechanism: Realised data-center revenue at this scale confirms sustained pull-through of accelerators, memory and packaging.

evidence.excerpt: second-quarter revenue was $89.0 billion, up 18% from the previous quarter and up 117% from a year ago

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: the company's own quarterly results release.
